hypothesis: Run to the full 3000 steps with m2 spread over [0.01, 1], the gravity direction the model encodes is per-snapshot acceleration. The symbolic fit to the best accel_step-probe direction recovers r-dependence ~1/r^2 with orbit-scale (a^3) dependence and no positive m2 factor in both seeds, while the force-direction fit does not recover m2/r^2.
expected_if_true: In both seeds (12, 13) the accel_step-direction equation has an r exponent between -2.5 and -1.5 and a positive power of a (about a^3), with fit_error_vs_true_law < 0.2. accel_step beats its control by >= 0.1. The force-direction fit does not recover m2/r^2 (law_recovered false, or an r exponent near -1 as in seeds 10 and 11).
expected_if_false: At least one seed's accel_step-direction fit keeps an r exponent near -1 (as seed 11 did at step 2000) or has fit error >= 0.3, or the force-direction fit recovers m2/r^2 (law_recovered true). Either would mean the gravity direction is not cleanly per-snapshot acceleration.
